reason: The analyst's spec is thinner than mine (only size and age controls, outcome trimmed at 1%, one spec, no causal caveats). But it leaves out the post-treatment mgmt_rating_2023, as it should. Re-running with lagged productivity and all pre-period controls gives about 0.80–0.84 (SE about 0.24), against the analyst's 0.95. The positive conclusion holds, though the magnitude is somewhat overstated and the release should note it is observational.
